baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled ق ص ص in نَقُصُّ ... ٱلْقَصَصِ and the naming of ٱلْقُرْءَانَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The account is a route reconstructed step by step: ق ص ص follows an أثر and carries successive news, while ق ر ء gathers dispersed parts into a recitable whole. ح س ن evaluates not only attractive content but the beneficent craft of making relations traversable.

activation_trace.role: Trace-following supplies the literal step-by-step movement and makes narration function as pursuit of an event path.
Successive transmission of news supplies the serial form that turns isolated events into an account.
Gathering joins the followed traces into one operative whole rather than leaving them as fragments.
Beneficent, well-executed action makes 'best' name what the narration does for its recipient as well as its beauty.

changed_reading.before: 'The best of stories' primarily ranks this narrative above other narrative content.
changed_reading.after: It also names a revelatory procedure: gather dispersed events and follow their traces in an ordered route until their relations become readable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causal link between أَوْحَيْنَا, هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ, مِن قَبْلِهِ, and ٱلْغَٰفِلِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Hidden knowledge is delivered and inscribed into a form that can be followed. The prior condition is not merely an empty store of information: غ ف ل can image an unmarked road, while ق ص ص supplies the act of tracking. Revelation changes an unmarked 'before' into an oriented path.

activation_trace.role: Secret delivery supplies knowledge not available on the visible surface and initiates the transition out of unawareness.
Writing and inscription give the hidden delivery a durable mark that can orient subsequent reading.
The unmarked place or road materializes the prior condition as lack of signs rather than simple culpable ignorance.
Following an أثر supplies the motion by which newly available marks become a navigable account.
Temporal precedence fixes the unmarked condition as a real earlier phase that revelation reorients.

changed_reading.before: Before revelation, the addressee simply did not possess this information.
changed_reading.after: Before revelation, the field was effectively unmarked; the revealed account installs traces by which that formerly trackless material can be traversed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causal بِمَآ أَوْحَيْنَآ within an ayah that also stresses serial ق ص ص, gathered ق ر ء, prior time, and prior state.
baseline_models.mechanism: One compact, hidden, even rapid act of وحي is unfolded as a temporally staged account. ق ص ص serializes; ق ر ء marks a time that comes or delays; ك و ن and ق ب ل locate states in time. The ayah can therefore contrast concentrated disclosure with patient narrative expansion.

activation_trace.role: Speed and haste supply the concentrated arrival whose contents the account subsequently unfolds.
Successive news converts a concentrated disclosure into an extended sequence.
A time that arrives or is delayed makes timing part of how the gathered account yields its sense.
Occurrence and presence in time provide the changing states through which the disclosure is narrated.
The explicit earlier phase gives the unfolding a before from which changed awareness can be measured.

changed_reading.before: Revelation and narration are nearly interchangeable modes of giving the same content.
changed_reading.after: Revelation is the concentrated arrival, while the 'best account' is its deliberate temporal unfolding, letting what arrived together become intelligible in succession.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding signs, joined book, clarification, delivered descent, cognitive restraint, and distinguishing marks turn the baseline trace-route into a signposted epistemic path. This sharply activates the contrast between ق ص ص as following marks and غ ف ل as an unmarked road.

activation_trace.role: Trace-following anchors the changed reading in the focus and supplies movement along the contextual marks.
The unmarked-road image supplies the condition that the contextual signs and marks repair.
A visible sign supplies the route marker by which the previously unmarked material can be followed.
Joining one thing to another supplies the connective work that makes separate traces into a book.
Disclosure by speech or sign makes the route explanatory rather than merely visible.
Delivery of a thing supplies the downward transfer by which the signs reach the addressees.
Restraint from ignorance makes following the route a disciplined cognitive act.
A distinguishing mark reinforces the model in which taught knowledge is guidance by recognizable traces.

structural_cues: 12:1-2 place signs, a joined book, clarification, descent, Arabic articulation, and understanding immediately before the focus; 12:6 repeats teaching and knowing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible signs, joining, clarification, delivery, cognitive restraint, and a distinguishing mark; I infer that these operate as route markers for ق ص ص and counter the unmarked-road image of غ ف ل. A live alternative is that they certify intelligibility without implying navigation.

changed_reading.before: The revealed story removes ignorance by supplying missing facts.
changed_reading.after: The revealed story removes tracklessness: it joins events, marks their path, and disciplines the reader to follow how one sign leads to another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dream is a concealed beginning whose meaning lies ahead; interpretation returns it to its outcome, renewed report carries it, and completion closes the arc. The 'best account' therefore folds future fulfillment into an initial image and lets narration trace the interval between them.

activation_trace.role: Following the trace anchors the model as movement from the dream-sign through its later consequences.
Timing that comes or is delayed supplies the interval in which the initial image ripens into meaning.
The dream supplies a visible but not yet decoded beginning whose consequences the account can follow.
Return to an outcome supplies the backward relation by which later fulfillment discloses the beginning.
Renewed news supplies the reportable stages through which the latent outcome becomes narratable.
Attaining completion supplies the terminal pole that makes the earlier dream proleptic.

structural_cues: 12:4 places an ordered celestial dream before the narrated ordeal; 12:6 explicitly pairs interpretation with the completion of favor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dream, return-to-outcome, renewed report, and completion; I infer a temporal arrow from latent image through ordeal to disclosed outcome. The alternative is a simpler promise of interpretation without a claim about the form of the whole account.

changed_reading.before: The story recounts events in their past order.
changed_reading.after: The story is time-folded: an ending is latent in the first dream, and successive narration makes the interval itself the medium by which the beginning becomes legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command not to recount the dream is immediately tied to the risk of plotting. Narration is thus causally active: releasing a hidden image changes what hearers can scheme. The divine 'We recount' in the focus becomes a controlled disclosure whose timing is part of its beneficence.

activation_trace.role: Secret delivery anchors the focus as a managed movement from concealment to disclosure.
Recounting successive news supplies the prohibited act whose performance would alter the social field.
The dream supplies sensitive latent content whose audience matters.
Scheming supplies the adverse causal consequence that uncontrolled narration could enable.

structural_cues: 12:5 makes 'do not recount your dream' immediately conditional upon 'lest they scheme against you.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a prohibited recounting, a dream, and scheming; I infer the arrow that disclosure gives hearers actionable material. A live alternative is merely prudential family secrecy, but even that leaves recounting as an event-producing act.

changed_reading.before: Narration communicates events that are already causally complete.
changed_reading.after: Narration itself enters the causal chain: the best recounting is not maximal exposure but rightly timed release of hidden knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: A person is made absent in a depression and cavity, then becomes something a passing group can pick up. Against that material sequence, ق ص ص and ق ر ء read as recovery operations: follow what was hidden and gather what was cast out back into a coherent account.

activation_trace.role: Trace-following anchors the account as recovery of a deliberately interrupted path.
Gathering supplies reintegration of the hidden fragment into the larger whole.
A depression in which something disappears supplies the spatial mechanism of forced absence.
A cavity that receives something supplies the container in which the trace is interrupted but preserved.
Picking up what lies cast on the ground supplies the reversal from discarded fragment to recovered subject.

structural_cues: The branchless ط ر ح occurrence at 12:9 word 4 contributes only the structural act of casting away; 12:10 then places the cast-away subject in the hidden pit and anticipates retrieval by travelers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disappearance, a receiving cavity, and pickup; I infer that the focus account performs an analogous recovery at the level of sequence and meaning. The alternative is only a spatial episode with no metanarrative force.

changed_reading.before: The account preserves memory of a person who suffered concealment.
changed_reading.after: The account actively reverses concealment: it retrieves the cast-away trace, reconnects it, and denies the pit the power to become the final shape of the event.

context_deltas.mechanism: The brothers claim watchful protection; the father imagines predation occurring precisely during their heedlessness. غ ف ل is therefore not only missing knowledge but an exploitable lapse. The focus account can function as counter-vigilance, teaching the reader to notice where assurances, danger, and unattended intervals meet.

activation_trace.role: Exploiting another's lapse activates a threat-bearing sense of unawareness in the focus.
Alert guarding and little heedlessness supply the claimed protective opposite of the focus condition.
Predatory danger supplies what can enter through an unattended interval.
The repeated root locates exploitability inside the story and feeds that sharper danger back into the focus.

structural_cues: 12:12 promises guarding, while 12:13 fears consumption by the wolf 'while you are unaware,' placing protection and lapse in direct opposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies guarding, predation, and repeated unawareness; I infer that revealed narration trains protective attention by exposing the junction at which a lapse becomes usable. The alternative is that the repetition only describes negligence inside the plot.

changed_reading.before: Revelation replaces a neutral lack of prior knowledge.
changed_reading.after: Revelation also guards against exploitable inattention: the account makes the reader watch the exact intervals in which confident speech can hide danger.

context_deltas.mechanism: Inside the pit's hidden cavity, revelation promises that the concealed victim will one day report the perpetrators' deed while they lack fine awareness. This miniaturizes the focus sequence itself: hidden revelation generates future narration that reverses who knows, who speaks, and who is unaware.

activation_trace.role: Successive report anchors the promised future telling in the focus's act of narration.
Secretly delivered knowledge supplies the generative source from which later speech will emerge.
Concealment from eyes supplies the maximum external obscurity in which the inner disclosure occurs.
The receiving cavity gives the hidden revelation a spatial interior.
The repeated secret delivery reenacts the focus mechanism inside the narrated world.
A delivered report supplies the promised future act by which concealment will be verbally reversed.
Fine awareness supplies the cognitive term withheld from the perpetrators and makes the reversal epistemic as well as social.

structural_cues: 12:15 embeds revelation between enclosure in the hidden pit and a promise of later reporting, ending with the perpetrators' lack of awareness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosure, secret revelation, promised report, and absent fine awareness; I infer that this inner sequence mirrors 12:3 and makes narration a promised reversal of concealment. The alternative is a local consolation that only happens to reuse the focus vocabulary.

changed_reading.before: 12:3 announces an external narrator giving the addressee a previously unknown story.
changed_reading.after: The story contains its own seed of future narration: revelation speaks inside concealment and guarantees that the silenced subject will later become the knowing reporter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The brothers bring a wearable object marked red and present it through false speech and description. The focus account is thereby sharpened into forensic counter-narration: it follows relations among material traces, claims, and motives instead of accepting a staged object's advertised meaning.

activation_trace.role: Following traces anchors the focus as an inquiry into how the presented evidence was produced.
The worn shirt supplies the material exhibit around which the false account is staged.
Blood-red coloration supplies the visible mark used to make the exhibit persuade.
Contradiction of truth names the exhibit's evidentiary status and forces a counter-reading.
Saying what did not occur supplies the verbal fabrication attached to the material display.
Presenting a thing through its attributed features supplies the contested descriptive frame the account refuses to inherit.

structural_cues: 12:18 juxtaposes the brought shirt, lying blood, Jacob's rejection, and the brothers' description in one compact evidentiary scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exhibit, blood-color, falsehood, fabricated saying, and description; I infer that the focus account adjudicates relations among them rather than merely replacing one statement with another. The alternative is a moral contrast between truth and lie without a forensic narrative mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The best account is the true version opposed to a false report.
changed_reading.after: The best account shows how to read claims through traces: it exposes how an object can be made to lie by arrangement and how narration can recover the suppressed causal sequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's أَحْسَن is pulled away from aesthetic spectacle by 'beautiful patience' under deceptive description. Beauty becomes disciplined response: restraining panic, refusing the fabricated frame, and seeking help without pretending the wound is absent.

activation_trace.role: Well-executed beneficent action anchors 'best' in ethical performance rather than surface attractiveness alone.
Holding the self back from panic supplies the disciplined posture by which beauty acts under injury.
Beauty in form and action explicitly transfers aesthetic valuation into conduct.
Seeking aid supplies dependence rather than self-sufficient composure as part of the beautiful response.
Contested description supplies the false frame against which disciplined beauty must hold.

structural_cues: 12:18 places 'beautiful patience' and appeal for help directly against what the brothers describe.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-restraint, beauty in action, aid, and contested description; I infer that these specify one ethical dimension of أَحْسَن in the focus. The alternative is that 'beautiful' characterizes Jacob alone and does not feed back into the quality of the account.

changed_reading.before: 'Best' chiefly praises the story's beauty or excellence as a narrated object.
changed_reading.after: 'Best' also describes the mode of reception the account forms: a beautiful discipline that resists false description while bearing what cannot yet be resolved.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material analogy is surprising because it activates cutting, joining, darning, and sewing branches under words whose surface uses are narration, book, pickup, and counsel. It remains anchored in the focus through ق ص ص as even cutting and ق ر ء as gathering, with a coherent repair mechanism across context. Downstream prose should label it an exploratory craft-image, not claim that 'narrate' literally means to sew.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ق ص ص and ق ر ء in 12:3 jointly permit a cut-and-gather material model for how an account is made.

activation_trace.role: Even cutting supplies selection and clean segmentation of the narrative material.
Gathering supplies recombination of the selected pieces into a whole.
Joining one thing to another supplies the first contextual seam in the repair analogy.
Darning a garment and collecting rents or marks supplies repair of a field broken by concealment.
Sewing a tear supplies the functional closure by which separated narrative edges are rejoined.
The shirt supplies an actual textile object on which the account's competing joins and tears become materially imaginable.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the best account is skilled repair: it cuts cleanly, gathers torn and scattered traces, and stitches relations that deception tried to separate.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because pregnancy branches are distant from the surface senses of story, Qur'an, dream, and morning. It remains worth carrying because two focus roots independently supply visible pregnancy and a womb gathering a load, while the context begins with a dream whose outcome is still hidden. Downstream prose should render it only as a contained gestational analogy for latent meaning becoming visible.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines the pregnancy-becoming-visible branch of ق ص ص with the womb-gathering branch of ق ر ء under hidden وحي.

activation_trace.role: Pregnancy becoming visible supplies emergence of a previously hidden narrative condition.
A womb gathering a load supplies containment and maturation before disclosure.
Hidden delivery supplies the unseen seed whose contents are not immediately public.
The appearance of pregnancy supplies a context-side echo of a hidden state becoming perceptible in the dream.
What is carried inside pregnant bodies extends the image of an outcome borne invisibly through time.

changed_reading.before: Revelation immediately transfers complete narrative knowledge.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, revelation implants a latent whole that the account carries through time until its concealed relations become visible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets the requital branches of both ق ص ص and ص ب ر coexist with the surface phrase 'beautiful patience.' It remains anchored in أَحْسَنَ ٱلْقَصَصِ and in the context's explicit violence, patience, and beauty, producing a live tension between measured return and restraint. Downstream prose should present this as a latent legal-affective countercurrent, not gloss patience as retaliation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The matched-requital branch of focus ق ص ص sits under أَحْسَن and can be tested against the context's violence and beautiful patience.

activation_trace.role: Matched requital supplies a latent expectation that injury and response will be measured against one another.
Beneficent action beyond bare justice places ethical pressure on how any matched return is carried.
Taking life supplies the severe injury against which the latent question of requital arises.
Requital and legal return unexpectedly place the possibility of answering injury inside the word for patience.
Beauty in action contains the requital current within a disciplined and ethically evaluated response.

changed_reading.before: The story's excellence and Jacob's patience belong to separate aesthetic and moral registers.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the account holds measured requital inside beautiful restraint: it does not erase injury, but delays and ethically transforms the form of its answer.

strongest_changes: The account became a signposted route that converts the unmarked 'before' into traceable understanding.
The dream and 12:15 made narration temporally active: hidden revelation seeds a future report that reverses concealment and unawareness.
The pit sequence made narration a recovery operation, while the shirt and lying blood made it forensic counter-narration.
The context of beautiful patience revised أَحْسَن from surface excellence toward disciplined ethical response.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's compact ق ص ص / و ح ي / ق ر ء / غ ف ل network was repeatedly reenacted inside the context rather than merely explained by it: traces were hidden and recovered, revelation occurred inside concealment, reports altered events, and rival descriptions competed over material signs. That recursion sustained several coexisting readings without requiring one final synthesis.
remaining_uncertainties: The unmarked-road activation of غ ف ل is coherent with signs and traces, but may remain a material analogy rather than a governing sense.
The 12:15 miniaturization of the focus sequence may be a deliberate formal recursion or a powerful local echo.
The sewing, gestation, and requital outliers are branch-led and should retain explicit exploratory containment.
